title: The watering shot plays in a corner while she keeps control
tier_reason: It is the first Lab loop a new player sees in play, and Q-104 ruled it must never take control away.
ask: Build Q-104's ruling as written in design/13 'The watering shot' and design/09 The inset. The first time the neighbour waters during the cold open (her 'water' action through apply_action with actor 'neighbour'; systems/sim/cold_open.gd derives it), an inset card fades up in a corner of the screen showing the watering_beam loop from assets/anim/watering_beam/ (export item) at ×1, nearest-neighbour, on the Lab's sky colour, plays one pass at the manifest's rate, and fades down. It takes no input, sits in a corner the HUD's corner map leaves free (the HUD's interactive controls are corner cards; the inset must not cover one, nor the neighbour, nor the player), and plays once per farm. Presentation only: it is driven by watching the recorded action, never by anything the sim does differently. Headless runs skip it. Capture a PNG with a display and attach it.
first_action: Read ui/hud.gd's corner assignments and world/farm.gd's action-report path the crow's animation already listens to, and hang the inset off the same signal.
source_message: Filed from the 2026-09-10 brainstorm on where the Animation Lab loops enter play (P-15, Q-103, Q-104).
